diagnostic_evidence.quote: which by (\ref{fishinvbd}) and the Sobolev imbedding theorem defines an element of

issues.failure_explanation: Condition F gives continuity of I^{-1} only on H^eta_0 for eta >= eta_0. The claim that bar psi lies in H^kappa therefore needs kappa >= eta_0. With kappa < k - d/2 this needs k > eta_0 + d/2, but only k > eta_0 is assumed. The moment bound (momhat) also writes <I^{-1}x, I^{-1}x> = <I^{-2}x, x>, which uses an unproven L^2 self-adjointness of I^{-1}. The valid bound ||bar e_j||_{L^2} <~ lambda_j^{1+eta_0/2} again needs k - eta_0 > d/2 for summability.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Assume k > max(zeta + 5d/2, eta_0 + d/2). Replace the self-adjointness step in (momhat) by the direct bound ||I^{-1} e_j||_{H^{eta_0}} <~ lambda_j^{eta_0/2}.
issues.overall_effect: The general BvM theorem is unsupported when eta_0 + d/2 >= k > eta_0. The reaction-diffusion application is unaffected because eta_0 can be taken close to 2 + d/2.
issues.title: Hypothesis on k does not ensure kappa >= eta_0, which the inversion of the information operator needs
issues.why_classification: A local strengthening of a parameter condition plus a one-line bound restores the proof. The application still satisfies the condition.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: For the second term we have from $\vartheta-\vartheta_0 = \sqrt N(\theta-\theta_0)$

issues.failure_explanation: Since vartheta - vartheta_0 = sqrt N (theta - theta_0), the region ||vartheta - vartheta_0|| > 1 corresponds to ||theta - theta_0|| > N^{-1/2}, not > 1. The localised posterior contracts only at rate tilde delta_N, which is much larger than N^{-1/2}. So the third term does not vanish, and the bound on the second term uses the wrong event.

issues.overall_effect: The proof of the exponential W_1 approximation is invalid as written. The statement itself appears correct.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: and to hold under our weaker hypothesis (\ref{zetabus})

issues.failure_explanation: The entropy and chaining bound requires ||g_{theta,psi} - g_{theta',psi}||_infty <~ ||theta - theta'||_{H^zeta} for arbitrary pairs. Condition D(zetabus) only controls G(theta) - G(theta_0) at the fixed point theta_0. The proof even writes ||theta - theta_0|| where a modulus in theta - theta' is needed, so the covering bound for the class in theta is not established.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Strengthen Condition D to the two-point estimate ||G(theta) - G(vartheta)||_infty <= c ||theta - vartheta||_{H^zeta} on balls, and correct the chaining display. Drop the claim of a weaker hypothesis.
issues.overall_effect: Control of the stochastic remainders, and hence the general BvM theorem, is unsupported under Condition D as stated. The reaction-diffusion case satisfies the stronger two-point estimate (h2estimate).
issues.title: Chaining needs a two-point Lipschitz modulus that Condition D does not provide
issues.why_classification: The general theorem's hypothesis must be strengthened and an advertised weakening withdrawn. The method, rates and application survive.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: noting that the $C^1([0,T], C^1)$-norm of $V=f'(\tilde u)$ is bounded

issues.failure_explanation: In the mean value theorem the intermediate point s = s(t,x) depends on (t,x) with no regularity. So tilde u, and hence V = f'(tilde u), need not be C^1 in t or x. Lemma paristexas requires V in C^1([0,T], C^1), and the chain-rule computation treats s as constant, so the verification of Condition E via (dochparis) is invalid as written.

failure_location.quote: where we have used the mean value theorem with mean values

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use the integral form V = integral_0^1 f'(s u_theta + (1-s) u_{theta_0}) ds, which inherits the same C^1([0,T], C^1) bounds by the same computation.
issues.overall_effect: The verification of the Lipschitz stability Condition E for reaction-diffusion is unsupported as written.

issues.failure_explanation: Taylor's theorem gives |m| <~ |w|^2 pointwise, so ||m||_{L^2} <~ ||w||_{L^4}^2. This is not bounded by ||w||_{L^2}^2. Near t = 0, w is about h, which need only lie in L^2-type balls. The bound sup_t ||r(t)||_{L^2} <~ sup_t ||m(t)||_{L^2} <~ ||h||_{L^2}^2 therefore fails. Using ||w||_infty gives only ||h||_{H^zeta} ||h||_{L^2}.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use ||m(s)||_{L^1} <~ ||w(s)||_{L^2}^2 <~ ||h||_{L^2}^2 together with an L^1 -> L^2 parabolic smoothing estimate of order (t-s)^{-d/4}, which is integrable for d <= 3, via Duhamel. Alternatively, weaken Condition C to ||h||_{L^2}||h||_{H^zeta} and re-check the rates.
issues.overall_effect: Condition C (quadratic linearisation in L^2) for reaction-diffusion, used in the BvM theorems and in the linearisation step of Theorem ganzwien, is unproven.
issues.title: Quadratic remainder bounded with ||w^2||_{L^2} <= ||w||_{L^2}^2, which is false
issues.why_classification: A contained new estimate (or a reworking of the rates) is needed. The main results plausibly survive.

issues.failure_explanation: Integrating U'(2t) over [0, epsilon/4] gives (U(epsilon/2) - h)/2, so A(h) = -h/2 + ... and I = -(1/2) Id + compact, not -Id + compact. Remark clever's decomposition I*I = -Delta^{-1} + ... is likewise off by the factor 1/2 (compare the heat case, where the operator is approximately (1/2)(-Delta)^{-1}).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace -Id by -(1/2) Id in the proof and -Delta^{-1} by -(1/2) Delta^{-1} in (infoapprox). The Fredholm argument is unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: The stated structure of the information operator is wrong by a constant. The Fredholm conclusion of Theorem raf is unaffected.
issues.title: Missing factor 1/2 in the identity part of the information operator
